text_en: Let every person be subject to the governing authorities; for there is no authority except from God, and those authorities that exist have been instituted by God.
text_cn: 每人要服从上级有权柄的人，因为没有权柄不是从天主来的，所有的权柄都是由天主规定的。

text_en: Therefore whoever resists authority resists what God has appointed, and those who resist will incur judgment.
text_cn: 所以谁反抗权柄，就是反抗天主的规定，而反抗的人就是自取处罚。

text_en: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you wish to have no fear of the authority? Then do what is good, and you will receive its approval;
text_cn: 因为长官为行善的人，不是可怕的；为行恶的人，才是可怕的。你愿意不怕掌权的吗？你行善吧！那就可由他得到称赞，

text_en: for it is God’s servant for your good. But if you do what is wrong, you should be afraid, for the authority does not bear the sword in vain! It is the servant of God to execute wrath on the wrongdoer.
text_cn: 因为他是天主的仆役，是为相帮你行善；你若作恶，你就该害怕，因为他不是无故带剑；他既是天主的仆役，就负责惩罚作恶的人；

text_en: Therefore one must be subject, not only because of wrath but also because of conscience.
text_cn: 所以必须服从，不只是为怕惩罚，而也是为了良心。

text_en: For the same reason you also pay taxes, for the authorities are God’s servants, busy with this very thing.
text_cn: 为此，你们也该完粮，因为他们是天主的差役，是专为尽这义务的。

text_en: Pay to all what is due them—taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
text_cn: 凡人应得的，你们要付清；该给谁完粮，就完粮；该给谁纳税，就纳税；该敬畏的，就敬畏；该尊敬的，就尊敬。

text_en: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for the one who loves another has fulfilled the law.
text_cn: 除了彼此相爱外，你们不可再欠人什么，因为谁爱别人，就满全了法律。

text_en: The commandments, “You shall not commit adultery; You shall not murder; You shall not steal; You shall not covet”; and any other commandment, are summed up in this word, “Love your neighbor as yourself. ”
text_cn: 其实“不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可贪恋，”以及其他任何诫命，都包含在这句话里：就是“爱你的近人如你自己。”

text_en: Love does no wrong to a neighbor; therefore, love is the fulfilling of the law.
text_cn: 爱不加害于人，所以爱就是法律的满全。

text_en: Besides this, you know what time it is, how it is now the moment for you to wake from sleep. For salvation is nearer to us now than when we became believers;
text_cn: 再者，你们该认清这个时期，现在已经是由睡梦中醒来的时辰了，因为我们的救恩，现今比我们当初信的时候更临近了。

text_en: the night is far gone, the day is near. Let us then lay aside the works of darkness and put on the armor of light;
text_cn: 黑夜深了，白日已近，所以我们该脱去黑暗的行为，佩戴光明的武器；

text_en: let us live honorably as in the day, not in reveling and drunkenness, not in debauchery and licentiousness, not in quarreling and jealousy.
text_cn: 行动要端庄，好像在白天一样，不可狂宴豪饮，不可淫乱放荡，不可争斗嫉妒；

text_en: Instead, put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to gratify its desires.
text_cn: 但该穿上主耶稣基督；不应只挂念肉性的事，以满足私欲。
